comments.text: What if, return flight gets cancelled and travel days get increased.? Should I mention 2-3 additional days while applying?

comments.author: @Marytechinfo
comments.text:
Yes, it is wise and recommended to add a buffer of 2 to 3 extra days to your intended exit date when applying for your Vietnam tourist e-visa. 

Standard tourist e-visas allow a maximum stay of up to 90 days, so adding a small buffer easily fits within allowable limits.
